description: Defines the QuicSpdyStreamBodyManager class responsible for managing request stream body data in QUIC protocol implementation, including buffering, reading, and tracking body fragments and non-body data.

classes.name: QuicSpdyStreamBodyManager
classes.description: Manages body and non-body data fragments for a QUIC request stream, providing methods to process incoming data, buffer body fragments, and facilitate reading.

methods.name: OnNonBody
methods.description: Called when non-body data is received; returns the number of bytes to mark as consumed.

methods.name: OnBody
methods.description: Adds received body data to internal buffer.

methods.name: OnBodyConsumed
methods.description: Marks a specified number of body bytes as consumed; returns total bytes to mark as consumed including interleaving non-body bytes.

methods.name: PeekBody
methods.description: Prepares iovec structures to point to available body fragments without consuming data.

methods.name: ReadBody
methods.description: Copies body data into provided iovec structures and consumes the data.

methods.name: HasBytesToRead
methods.description: Checks if there are body fragments available to read.

methods.name: total_body_bytes_received
methods.description: Returns total number of body bytes received.
